base.your_solution: Juspay, a cloud-native merchant acquiring platform for banks in India
base.key_value_points:
Merchant onboarding in days instead of weeks
One integration for many payment methods and PSPs
Reconciliation during the day instead of overnight batches
base.known_objections: a cloud platform run by a vendor is a material outsourcing arrangement; where is card and transaction data stored and processed; what happens to our merchants if the vendor has an outage
base.competitive_context: the bank's current on-premise acquiring stack
base.budget_context: illustrative: $500,000 a year from the payments business budget
base.urgency_drivers: illustrative: the support contract for the current acquiring stack ends in 9 months

base.customer_industry: Mid-sized private sector bank in India, transaction banking for corporate clients
base.customer_challenges: Corporate clients ask for API-based escrow and virtual accounts; each new product takes about 6 months to build in-house; about 30% of collections are reconciled by hand; the RFP requires data stored in India and a full audit trail
base.your_solution: TBX transaction banking platform: escrow and virtual accounts; payments and collections APIs; automated reconciliation; a white-label corporate banking portal
base.key_differentiators: Integrated with 40+ banks and serving 220+ clients (company-reported); delivered through APIs and SaaS; the fastest bank integration in India
base.pricing: Illustrative: one-time implementation fee of Rs 40 lakh; annual platform fee of Rs 1.2 crore for up to 5 million API calls; Rs 0.50 per call above that
base.implementation_approach: Illustrative: discovery 2 weeks; sandbox integration 6 weeks; user acceptance testing with 3 pilot corporate clients 4 weeks; go-live in week 14
base.success_metrics: Illustrative targets: share of collections reconciled automatically from 70% to 95%; time to onboard a new corporate client from 6 weeks to 2 weeks
